history_notes: Neighbouring junior club of Fohenagh before amalgamation (official club history).
Officers from both clubs began juvenile amalgamation talks in the 1990s due to falling numbers; Juvenile club founded 1999; full adult amalgamation 2002.
Mattie Kilroy published a local history booklet 'Ahascragh Hurling Club' (1984; cited in GAA bibliography lists).
